crossRefs.note: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;
both low and high, rich and poor together.
Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know the Yahweh’s way, nor the law of their God.
I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of Yahweh, and the law of their God.” But…
for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person…
You went to the king with oil, increased your perfumes, sent your ambassadors far off, and degraded yourself even to…
Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has…
These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body; but aren’t of any…
When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
Joshua said to the people, “You can’t serve Yahweh, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your…
Yet, Yahweh, you know all their counsel against me to kill me. Don’t forgive their iniquity. Don’t blot out their sin…
but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”

translations.web: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.
translations.bsb: So mankind is brought low, and man is humbled— do not forgive them!
translations.kjv: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive
translations.asv: And the mean man is bowed down, and the great man is brought low: therefore forgive them not.
